meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 它会扫描你订阅或资源组里的 Azure Functions、App Service 资源,按区域冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探测、多区域故障转移四项列出检查表,并在你确认后逐步执行修复(az CLI 命令或 Bicep/Terraform 补丁)。
howto.when: 当你提到「评估可靠性」「区域冗余」「多区域故障转移」等关键词,或要求检查、改善 Function App、Web App 的高可用性与灾备时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估这个资源组里应用的可靠性
say.note: 输出按功能排列的检查表

say.text: 我的应用服务计划是区域冗余的吗?
say.note: 报告哪些已开启、哪些缺失

say.text: 帮我给 Function App 开启区域冗余
say.note: 会先列出改动和费用再执行

howto.what_en: Scans your Azure Functions and App Service resources, lists a checklist of zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes and multi-region failover, then applies fixes via az CLI or Bicep/Terraform patches after your confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "assess reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover" and similar, or ask to check or improve high availability for Functions or App Service.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of the apps in this resource group
Is my App Service plan zone redundant?
Enable zone redundancy for my Function App
